newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen higher at start.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen higher at start.

text.p: High tech stocks are expected to lead Wall Street higher at the start on Tuesday after Motorola Inc and Advanced Micro Devices Inc reported better than forecast first quarter earnings.

"These two companies have surprised the Street, and that will build further confidence in the rest of the high tech group," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments. "The group has been battered recently and questions have been raised as to whether it was heading lower."
On Monday, the stock market extended its bounce from Friday which itself came on the heels of two weeks of trading which saw the Dow lose more than 278 points.
